cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. This dripping tap is our chance to replace the whole sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only needs a washer. I've bought one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Excellent. We'll fit it while the sink's out and replace that swollen worktop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The worktop runs under every cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll empty the kitchen. With the cupboards out, we can finally fix the layout.

mechanism: A uses expert repair-sequence corrections to make each small plumbing fact justify a larger, more disruptive kitchen project.
confusable: D24 merely infers a bigger problem; D48 actively proposes solving it through broader intervention, with each new fact expanding the work.
comparison: Caf? alternative disrupts business operations; home alternative escalates from a washer to sink, worktop and layout.
seedUse: Dripping tap, bought washer and worktop under cupboards derive from D48-a; S03 adds component-versus-system and removal-order distinctions.
